status: registered before any A2b training or scoring. A2 (label-free) results are known (MS-168); MS-96/97 (cache + decoder adaptation beats raw retraining 8/8) is known.
question: In a NEW region with only K labelled tiles per class, do OlmoEarth per-acquisition embeddings (pre, post, difference) plus a small head beat the same head on AlphaEarth annual embeddings and on raw Sentinel-2 bands, after pre-training the head on the other regions?
scenario: Stage 2 of the rapid tool: label-free first look (A1b/A2) -> a person marks 5 landslide and 5 non-landslide tiles in the new region (minutes) -> refined map.

data.tiles: A2 tiles (a2/tiles.json: Sen12Landslides, 8 regions, <=100 positive + <=100 negative per region), restricted to tiles with AlphaEarth Y and Y-1 so every method sees the same tiles
data.dates: A2 dates per tile: pre = last kept acquisition before the event, post = first kept at/after it
data.labels: landslide mask pooled to the 40 m token grid (32x32); token positive if fraction >= .5, negative if 0, ignored otherwise; all tokens of negative tiles negative

secondary: itogon (8 positive tiles only: K=5 leaves 3 query positives; reported, not in the verdict)
target_regions.not_targets: italy (positives only), newzealand (negatives only), kyrgyzstan2 (1 positive) - used only as source regions
target_regions.why: A2 composition: a target needs both classes with query tiles left after the support draw

features_same_head.olmo: OlmoEarth v1 Base single-date S2 embeddings (existing caches): concat(pre, post, post-pre), 2304 ch at 40 m  <- full method
features_same_head.aef: AlphaEarth V1 annual: concat(Y-1, Y, Y-(Y-1)), 192 ch, 10 m pooled to 40 m
features_same_head.s2raw: raw Sentinel-2 10 bands reflectance at pre and post + difference + NDVI pre/post/diff, 33 ch, pooled to 40 m (standard supervised practice)
secondary_variants: olmo_post (post only, 768 ch): does the pair matter

head: per-channel standardisation (source statistics) -> 1x1 conv 128 -> GELU -> 3x3 conv 128 -> GELU -> 1x1 conv -> token logit; identical for every feature set

training.source: all tiles of the 7 other regions, BCE with pos_weight = min(n_neg/n_pos, 10), AdamW lr 1e-3, 1500 steps, batch 32 tiles
training.adapt: continue on the target support (K positive + K negative tiles), 100 steps, lr 3e-4
training.draws: 10 support draws per region and K (deterministic seeds); 3 source seeds; K=20 only where >= 30 positives
training.query: all target tiles not in the support

scores.T1: tile AUC positive vs negative query tiles; tile score = 95th percentile of token probabilities
scores.T2: token AUC inside positive query tiles

reference_label_free: A2 label-free olmo_norm, aef_raw, dndvi_raw on the same query tiles (context only)

verdict_primary_K5.per_region: AUC averaged over 10 draws x 3 seeds
verdict_primary_K5.strongest_baseline: max of aef and s2raw by macro mean over the 4 primary regions, chosen per metric
verdict_primary_K5.meaningful: olmo - strongest >= .05 in macro mean on T1 AND T2, and olmo > strongest in >= 3 of 4 primary regions on each
verdict_primary_K5.t1_only / t2_only: the condition holds for one metric
verdict_primary_K5.also_reported: K=0 and K=20 with the same rule; secondary variants; per-draw win fraction

known_limits: only 4 primary target regions, all events 2018-2019 (AlphaEarth Y-1 exists)
AlphaEarth annual Y mixes pre- and post-event months differently by event month (chimanimani March vs hiroshima July)
A2 tiles are capped at 100 per class per region
the pooled A2 T1 mixed regions with one class only (italy positives, newzealand negatives); A2b evaluates within each target region
